modes.cue_notes: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot drawn in toward the inner thigh of the extended leg (like a half butterfly or Janu Sirsasana position). Round forward over the extended leg, allowing the spine to flex. Head hangs, hands rest wherever comfortable. Shift the torso slightly toward the extended leg to target the lateral hamstring. Hold each side.

source: Traditional yin yoga; see Paul Grilley, Bernie Clark, Sarah Powers
notes: Isolates the hamstring and posterior hip of one side at a time. The kidney and bladder meridians run along the back of the extended leg. More accessible than full Caterpillar for tight hamstrings.
